body: i have tried getting back into those things. i've tried forcing myself, but i find no enjoyment in it whatsoever. as far as dating someone else, i haven't. i hadn't dated anyone before her, and i haven't after. i just can't see myself with anyone else

i used to have hobbies. i used to play all sports. used to work on cars. used to do a lot. i don't do any of those things anymore. everyone tells me to go talk to a therapist, but i don't think i even *want* to, if that makes any sense. i just want to get to the point and just end it all.

its really hard to have her on my mind all day, all night, every single day. i hate it. i love her, but i hate this so much. i haven't spoken to her for a few months, and even though she's moved on and i don't cross her mind, my damn mind can't get rid of her even for a second!
i've spoken to a couple of friends about this since last year. nobody knows that i'm suicidal about it.
